title: Detailed cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="38" ry="6" fill="#3a2a10" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Main cheese body - wedge shape -->
  <path d="M15 75 L50 40 L85 75 Z" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  
  <!-- Back face of wedge (three-quarter view) - slightly darker -->
  <path d="M15 75 L50 40 L50 30 L15 65 Z" fill="#E8B820"/>
  
  <!-- Top face -->
  <path d="M50 40 L85 75 L85 65 L50 30 Z" fill="#FFE566"/>
  
  <!-- Front face highlight -->
  <path d="M50 40 L85 75 L50 75 Z" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  
  <!-- Side face shading -->
  <path d="M15 75 L50 40 L50 75 Z" fill="#E8B820"/>
  
  <!-- Rind stripe on back edge -->
  <path d="M15 75 L50 40 L50 42 L17 75 Z" fill="#D4A017"/>
  <path d="M50 40 L85 75 L83 75 L50 42 Z" fill="#D4A017"/>
  
  <!-- Hole 1 - large -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="65" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#C49A10"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="64" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#B8890E"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="64.5" rx="5.5" ry="3.5" fill="#8B6508"/>
  
  <!-- Hole 2 - medium -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="68" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#C49A10"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="67" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#B8890E"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="67.5" rx="3.8" ry="2.8" fill="#8B6508"/>
  
  <!-- Hole 3 - small -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="73" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#C49A10"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="72.5" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#B8890E"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="72.8" rx="2.2" ry="1.5" fill="#8B6508"/>
  
  <!-- Hole 4 - tiny -->
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="74" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#C49A10"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="73.5" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#B8890E"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="73.8" rx="1.7" ry="1.3" fill="#8B6508"/>
  
  <!-- Hole 5 - on top face -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="55" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#D4A017"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="54" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#C49A10"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="54.5" rx="2.8" ry="2" fill="#A07808"/>
  
  <!-- Hole 6 - top face small -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="63" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#D4A017"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="62.5" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#C49A10"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="62.8" rx="1.7" ry="1.3" fill="#A07808"/>
  
  <!-- Rim highlight on top edges -->
  <path d="M50 40 L50 30 L53 30 L53 40 Z" fill="#FFEE99" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Cheese crumb detail -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="78" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="80" r="1.2" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="82" r="1" fill="#FFE566"/>
  
  <!-- Top edge highlight -->
  <path d="M50 40 L85 75" stroke="#FFEE99" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M15 75 L50 40" stroke="#FFEE99" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
